text: India’s Yashasvi Jaiswal and Sri Lanka’s Asitha Fernando have each been fined 25 per cent of their match fee and handed one demerit point for inappropriate physical contact during the Colombo Test.#YashasviJaiswal#AsithaFernando#Cricket#ColomboTest#PakistanTV
translated_text: 印度的 Yashasvi Jaiswal 和斯里兰卡的 Asitha Fernando 在科伦坡测试期间因不当身体接触而分别被罚款 25% 的比赛费用，并被扣一分。#YashasviJaiswal#AsithaFernando#Cricket#ColomboTest#PakistanTV

text: Coco Gauff defeated Jessica Pegula 6-2 6-4 to win her first title of 2026 at the Cincinnati Open. The victory makes Gauff a two-time champion in Cincinnati and boosts her confidence ahead of the US Open.#CocoGauff#CincinnatiOpen#WTA#USOpen#PakistanTV
translated_text: 可可·高夫 (Coco Gauff) 在辛辛那提公开赛上以 6-2 6-4 击败杰西卡·佩古拉 (Jessica Pegula)，赢得了她 2026 年的首个冠军头衔。这场胜利使高芙在辛辛那提两度夺冠，并增强了她在美国公开赛前的信心。#CocoGauff#CincinnatiOpen#WTA#USOpen#PakistanTV

text: Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir, Chief of Army Staff and Chief of Defence Forces, and Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi meet Iranian Interior Minister Eskandar Momeni.@MOIofficialGoP#AsimMunir#MohsinNaqvi#PakistanIran#IranPakistanRelations#PakistanTV
translated_text: 陆军参谋长兼国防军参谋长赛义德·阿西姆·穆尼尔元帅和内政部长穆赫辛·纳克维会见伊朗内政部长埃斯坎达尔·莫梅尼。@MOIofficialGoP#AsimMunir#MohsinNaqvi#PakistanIran#IranPakistanRelations#PakistanTV

text: The Asian Cricket Council approves key governance changes, electing Khalid Al Zarooni as vice-president and new executive board members for the 2026–2028 term. The moves also clear the way for Afghanistan to join the rotation for the ACC presidency.#AsianCricketCouncil
translated_text: 亚洲板球理事会批准了关键的治理变革，选举 Khalid Al Zarooni 为 2026-2028 年任期的副主席和新的执行委员会成员。这些举措也为阿富汗加入 ACC 轮值主席国扫清了道路。#AsianCricketCouncil

text: Miyu Yamashita fired a four-under-par 66 to polish off a wire-to-wire victory in the LPGA Canadian Women's Open on Sunday, beating fellow Japanese player Yuri Yoshida by nine strokes.#MiyuYamashita#LPGA#CanadianWomensOpen#Golf#PakistanTV
translated_text: 周日，山下美悠 (Miyu Yamashita) 在 LPGA 加拿大女子公开赛上打出低于标准杆 4 杆 66 杆的成绩，以九杆优势击败日本选手吉田尤里 (Yuri Yoshida)，取得全场胜利。#MiyuYamashita#LPGA#CanadianWomensOpen#Golf#PakistanTV

text: Washington-based journalist Syed Faisal Ali Shah says the “Trump administration is seriously considering collective sanctions, with the United States also seeking to persuade allied countries to join the US-led sanctions effort to increase pressure on Iran.”#USIran
translated_text: 华盛顿记者赛义德·费萨尔·阿里·沙阿表示，“特朗普政府正在认真考虑集体制裁，美国也在寻求说服盟国加入美国主导的制裁行动，以加大对伊朗的压力。”#USIran

text: Oil prices fell on Monday as investors braced for details of a US plan to isolate the Iranian economy that President Donald Trump billed as the "most crushing" financial operation ever against Tehran. West Texas Intermediate fell 1.9% to $85.39 a barrel and Brent crude dropped
translated_text: 周一油价下跌，因投资者等待美国孤立伊朗经济计划的细节，唐纳德·特朗普总统称该计划为有史以来针对德黑兰的“最具毁灭性”的金融行动。西德克萨斯中质原油下跌 1.9%，至每桶 85.39 美元，布伦特原油下跌

text: Kazakhstan's ruling party comfortably won Sunday's elections to a new single-chamber parliament, exit polls suggested, consolidating President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev's hold on power. Three exit polls reported by state television gave the pro-Tokayev Adilet party between 70 and 72
translated_text: 出口民调显示，哈萨克斯坦执政党轻松赢得周日新一院议会选举，巩固了总统托卡耶夫的权力。国家电视台报道的三项出口民意调查显示，支持托卡耶夫的阿迪莱特党的支持率在 70 至 72 之间

text: Indian police used excessive force, including electric shock devices and pellet guns, against youth-led protests that forced the education minister to resign last month, Amnesty International said Monday.#IndiaProtests#AmnestyInternational#HumanRights#IndiaNews#PakistanTV
translated_text: 国际特赦组织周一表示，印度警方对青年领导的抗议活动过度使用武力，包括电击装置和弹丸枪，迫使教育部长上个月辞职。#IndiaProtests#AmnestyInternational#HumanRights#IndiaNews#PakistanTV

text: U.S. Treasury to unveil new Iran sanctions after Trump warned of "economic D-Day" for Tehran.

text: Departing Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt praised President Donald Trump at a rally in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina, on Friday, telling the crowd that it has been the “honor of my life to serve as the White House press secretary.”
translated_text: 周五，即将离任的新闻秘书卡罗琳·莱维特在南卡罗来纳州默特尔比奇的一次集会上赞扬了唐纳德·特朗普总统，她告诉人群，“担任白宫新闻秘书是我一生的荣幸”。

text:
Sean Grayson, the former Sangamon County Sheriff's deputy convicted of murdering Sonya Massey in her home in 2024, died on Sunday, according to his attorney.

Grayson had been battling Stage 4 colon cancer, for which he was undergoing treatment.

Grayson, 32, was found guilty
translated_text:
前桑加蒙县副警长肖恩·格雷森 (Sean Grayson) 因 2024 年在家中谋杀索尼娅·马西 (Sonya Massey) 而被定罪，据他的律师称，他已于周日去世。

格雷森一直在与第四期结肠癌作斗争，目前正在接受治疗。

32岁的格雷森被判有罪
